question.problem:
Using the normal approximation to the binomial distribution, approximate the probability that $58$ people say "yes" on a yes/no survey in a randomly selected sample of $100$ people if the probability that a person answers "yes" is $0.5.$ Give your final answer to three decimal places.

*Hint: The data below is taken from the table of values of the cumulative distribution function $Φ(z)$ for the standard normal distribution. *

| $z$ | $\,0.00\,$ | $\,0.01\,$ | $\,0.02\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\,1.5\,$ | $\,0.9332\,$ | $\,0.9345\,$ | $\,0.9357\,$ |
| $\,1.6\,$ | $\,0.9452\,$ | $\,0.9463\,$ | $\,0.9474\,$ |
| $\,1.7\,$ | $\,0.9554\,$ | $\,0.9564\,$ | $\,0.9573\,$ |
